def test_export_keeps_all_editions_inactive_and_sorted():
    from catalog import build_export
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert [(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books] == [
        ("9780000000011", "large-print"), ("9780000000011", "paper"),
        ("9780000000028", "paper"), ("9780000000035", "paper")]
    assert [b["title"] for b in books] == ["Straße Atlas", "Straße Atlas", "Zebra Tales", "apple Almanac"]
    assert any(not b["active"] for b in books)
    assert all(b["key"] == b["title"].casefold() for b in books)


def test_key_can_be_longer_than_title():
    from catalog import build_export
    b = build_export(load())["books"][0]
    assert (len(b["title"]), len(b["key"])) == (12, 13)


def test_prefix_search_folds_query_and_keeps_title():
    from catalog import build_export, prefix_search
    hits = prefix_search(build_export(load()), "STRASSE")
    assert len(hits) == 2 and {h["title"] for h in hits} == {"Straße Atlas"}
    assert [h["title"] for h in prefix_search(build_export(load()), "Zeb")] == ["Zebra Tales"]
